_comment: bugsweep configuration. Empty command strings mean auto-detect. Edit caps to bound cost/runtime on unattended runs.

adversarial._comment: K is the number of fresh native Referee executions for high/critical findings. First assessments are verdict-blind and must have a strict CONFIRMED majority. Different prompts do not establish statistical independence; confidence is uncalibrated. Every fix also requires executable red/green proof. Effective K is capped at referee_votes_cap.

context._comment: Coverage-first cross-run scope. State lives in .bugsweep/state/ (gitignored). The hunt spans the invocation's frozen tracked-file scope; these only reprioritize that queue.

priority._comment: Local-only, deterministic why-now evidence. Signals reorder investigation but never confirm a finding, relax fix gates, or narrow the frozen invocation scope. Fresh, provenanced project snapshots may be written to .bugsweep/priority-signals.jsonl; Bugsweep never calls their remote services itself. Signal outcomes are observed for yield reporting only and never mutate weights automatically.

recall._comment: Recall mode retains plausible unresolved findings for human review. Legacy confidence values are uncalibrated judgments, not probabilities. Near misses never authorize fixes or bypass executable proof.

analyzers._comment: Explicit CodeQL/Semgrep configurations may produce bounded SARIF through the execution provider. Importers only read coordinator-captured artifacts. No tool/rule downloads or PATH discovery. Hits guide investigation; they never confirm bugs, raise confidence, or narrow scope. Missing evidence is unavailable, not a zero-hit scan.

execution._comment: Absolute path to an operator-owned policy outside the target. Empty means target execution unavailable. Automatic fixes require a pinned Docker image/engine with verified isolation, denied network, limits, deadline and trusted artifact capture. No host-shell fallback.

verify._comment: Legacy flaky_reruns is retained for configuration compatibility. Structured proof does not excuse a regression after a later pass. Missing/skipped previously passing tests and new failing identities block automatic landing.
